new_skills.name: openflow-observability
new_skills.description: Troubleshoot Openflow connector / runtime / deployment issues via Snowsight SQL diagnostics, and run a narrow set of confirmation-gated SQL actions on SQL-managed runtimes. Use when: connector is unhealthy, table FAILED, runtime stuck or OOM, EAI / network issues, restart / resume / suspend runtime, attach EAI to runtime. Triggers: openflow, connector, runtime, deployment, EAI, table FAILED, openflow troubleshoot, openflow runtime.
